payload.claim: The compound assertion `"max(x, 0)" in failure.message and "x" in failure.message` cannot actually tell whether `mutant.replace` (`"x"`) is rendered in the failure message, because `"x"` is already a substring of `"max(x, 0)"` which the first half of the assertion already requires. Deleting `-> {mutant.replace!r}` from the message-format f-string in `saffron/gates/core/witness.py` (leaving only `mutant.find!r ... in {mutant.file}`) would still leave this line green, even though the failure would then no longer name the replacement half of `criterion.mutant` as the comment `# the edit` claims it verifies.
